name: Harness A
change: Research reference. The model chooses what to investigate and when to publish or update an answer.

name: Harness B
change: Harness A + a delivery check by the same model. It reviews a candidate answer and chooses to publish it, update or withdraw an existing answer, or leave the display unchanged.
short_change: A + same-model review of candidate answers.

name: Harness C
change: Harness B + resources reserved for later turns and limits on delivery checks. Adds partial answer edits and feedback when updates fail; removes duplicate old answer snapshots from model requests.
short_change: B + budget allocation, partial answer edits and update feedback; less repeated context.
